location_note: key (x, y) is the world-map lookup key; dest is the location number (10-174); chunk = 77 + dest; +5/+6/+7 bytes are undecoded, preserved raw; tail is 0x1066 except rec 454 (0x0000)
placement_note: x, y = party placement in the room; song_byte resolves to a song via the $32D0E picker (docs/sound.md §7.3; e.g. loc 15 byte 34 -> song 2 Enchanters, the picker default) — the byte->song mapping is owned by #030 audio
